name: Shapes
summary: Shapes (formerly DreamTeam, Tel Aviv, founded by ex-monday.com leaders) sells an AI-native, agentic HR/PeopleOS covering HR, IT and Finance processes, with an employee-facing AI chat, AI-generated workflows, agents that run admin work, and a build-your-own app/agent layer. It raised $24M combined seed and Series A (Series A $15M led by Entree Capital, 10 Dec 2025) and plans to more than double headcount. Its agents and chat read and act on sensitive employee data (salary, performance, leave) for hundreds of B2B customers in 79 countries, which is a high-risk AI use under the EU AI Act.
product: Modular PeopleOS: core HR, performance cycles, comp cycles, time off, attendance, surveys, people analytics, docs and eSign, plus AI foundations (build any view/tool by describing it, agents that run admin, AI-generated workflows, people data exposed to external AI).

ai_usage.what: Employee-facing AI chat that answers policy and HR questions from company docs; AI agents that carry admin load; natural-language generation of workflows, views, apps and agents on live people data; AI insights in performance, surveys and analytics. Verified in company_review.csv (ships_customer_facing_llm=yes, agentic=true, confidence medium).

compliance.eu_ai_act_exposure: high: AI used in employment (worker management, performance evaluation, pay) is an Annex III high-risk category; Shapes is a provider and its customers are deployers, with 79-country reach including the EU.
compliance.notes: Site footer shows GDPR and ISO badges (exact ISO standard not confirmed); homepage cites continuous audits, strict access controls, privacy safeguards. /security page returned 404.

why_now: On 10 Dec 2025 Shapes closed a $15M Series A (24M total) to double headcount, and by Oct 2026 it markets itself as 'the only HR platform actually built on AI', with agents and describe-to-build apps running on salary, performance and leave data while the EU AI Act high-risk employment obligations (Aug 2026 date, subject to the Digital Omnibus delay) are landing: it has no AI/security hire visible and needs guardrails before enterprise and EU deals scale.
likely_pains: Prompt injection through HR documents, tickets or employee free text steering the AI chat or agents
Cross-tenant and cross-employee data leakage (one employee's salary or review shown to another, or across customer tenants) via chat and agents
Agents taking destructive or unauthorised actions (changing comp, offboarding the wrong person, sending e-signature docs)
User-built agents and apps ('describe it and build it') bypassing policy and access rules
Biased or unlawful output in performance and hiring-adjacent insights; hallucinated policy answers (leave, pay) creating legal exposure
EU AI Act high-risk duties (logging, human oversight, risk management) plus GDPR on employee data, demanded by enterprise security reviews

persona_angles.angle: As Shapes lands bigger customers, security teams will ask how your HR agents are stopped from leaking salary data or acting on a prompt injection, and we give you a provable answer in days, not a quarter.

You let customers build their own agents by describing them, so what stops one of those agents from doing something your product never intended, and can you show customers an audit trail of what was blocked?

persona_angles.persona: CTO / Head of Engineering or AI
persona_angles.angle: We sit in front of your AI chat and agent tool calls with plain-language policies, checking every input, output and action in real time, so you ship agent features without building your own safety stack.
Employment AI is high-risk under the EU AI Act, and White Circle gives you logging, policy enforcement and human escalation as evidence for your deployers' audits.
